Speaker: Nazir
Text: Listener. Good. You can settle this before I settle it myself.
Notes: Automatische Szene; Veyra sitzt am Esstisch, Nazir steht mit gezogener Klinge ueber ihr, Szene startet < 800 Units

Speaker: Nazir
Text: This one walked through the Black Door like she owned the place. Say the word and I open her up.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: He's been saying that for an hour. I'm beginning to think he doesn't mean it.

Speaker: Babette
Text: Oh, he means it. He just hasn't decided where to start.

Speaker: Cicero
Text: Cicero knows that face! Cicero knows it! But from where, from where...
Notes: Platzhalter-Condition, echte Pruefung ueber Alias NHV_Sys_Sanctuary::Cicero (M1.4); Cicero kauert hinter einer Kiste

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Ah. So it's Cicero these days.
Notes: Platzhalter-Condition; leise, ohne aufzusehen. Keine Reaktion, keine Nachfrage; die Szene laeuft einfach weiter

Speaker: Player
Text: Who are you?

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Veyra Othren. Once of Bravil, once of Cheydinhal, once of a dozen sanctuaries that don't exist anymore.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: The family used to call me the Gleaner.

Speaker: Player
Text: The Gleaner?

Speaker: Veyra
Text: After the harvest, someone walks the fields and gathers what the reapers left behind.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: That was my work. I found the ones worth keeping.

Speaker: Player
Text: How did you get past the Black Door?

Speaker: Veyra
Text: The door asked me for the music of life. I knew the answer before your Redguard's grandmother was born.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: Careful, elf.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: I'm always careful. It's why I'm still breathing.

Speaker: Player
Text: Why are you here?

Speaker: Veyra
Text: The family grows thin, and I come. It has always been that way.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: So I came north. I found Falkreath in ashes. I was too late for them.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: I don't intend to be too late for you.

Speaker: Player
Text: Nazir, lower your blade. Let her talk.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: ...Fine. But it stays out of its sheath.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: A sensible compromise.

Speaker: Player
Text: Do it, Nazir.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Before he does, Listener, ask the Night Mother. If she wants me dead, I'll hold very still.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: ...The elf has a point. I hate that.

Speaker: Player
Text: I want you out of this Sanctuary.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: As you wish. I'll be at the Windpeak Inn.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: I've waited longer than you would believe. A few more days won't trouble me.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: An old assassin turns up the moment we're weakest, with a sad story and the right words.
Notes: Automatisch nach Option 1-5, einmalig; "password"→"words" (lore-editor-Fund 23.09., Ton weniger modern)

Speaker: Nazir
Text: That's exactly what a spy would do.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: It's exactly what a spy would do. So don't take my word for it. Take hers.
Notes: Blick zum Sarg der Night Mother → Stage 20

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Back already? Either you've changed your mind, or you've come to finish what Nazir started.

Speaker: Player
Text: Come back. The Night Mother will decide about you.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Wise. I'll follow you. Try not to walk too fast; I'm older than this town.
Notes: → Stage 20, Veyra per MoveTo zurueck in die Sanctuary

Speaker: Player
Text: Just making sure you're still here.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Still here. Still waiting. I'm very good at both.

Speaker: Player
Text: Mother, a stranger has come. She calls herself the Gleaner.
Notes: Topic am Actor der Night Mother

Speaker: NightMother
Text: My Listener. You come with a question on your lips.

Speaker: NightMother
Text: The Gleaner has come before, my Listener. She comes whenever the harvest fails.

Speaker: NightMother
Text: She gathered when the family was many, and when it was few. Let her gather now.

Speaker: Player
Text: Can she be trusted?

Speaker: NightMother
Text: Trust is for the living to squabble over. I know only this: her heart beats for Sithis.

Speaker: NightMother
Text: What she does with it is yours to watch.

Speaker: Player
Text: Why did she leave the family?
Notes: Option 2 von 5; setzt NHV_Q00_AskedLeave (CK: Alias-Variable oder Stage-Zwischenschritt, im CK festlegen)

Speaker: NightMother
Text: Ask her, my Listener. Her answer will tell you more than mine.

Speaker: Player
Text: Why have you never spoken to her?

Speaker: NightMother
Text: I speak to one. It has always been one.

Speaker: NightMother
Text: That is the burden of the Listener, and the wound of all the rest.

Speaker: Player
Text: What is she, Mother?

Speaker: NightMother
Text: She is the one who gathers. What else she is, the Void keeps. It does not share.
Notes: Veyras Alter/Natur bleibt bewusst ungeklaert, keine Aufloesung

Speaker: Player
Text: That is all I needed, Mother.

Speaker: Cicero
Text: Cicero remembers now! Cheydinhal! The pointy-eared lady who left!
Notes: Platzhalter-Condition, echte Pruefung ueber Alias NHV_Sys_Sanctuary::Cicero; "left" betont; faengt den Spieler auf dem Rueckweg ab

Speaker: Cicero
Text: Who left Cicero alone with Mother and the dust and the rats!

Speaker: Cicero
Text: Cicero talked to the rats for years, you know. They were terrible listeners. Terrible!

Speaker: Player
Text: She's here now. That counts for something.

Speaker: Cicero
Text: Does it? Does it count? Cicero will count. Cicero is very good at counting grudges.

Speaker: Player
Text: You have every right to be angry.

Speaker: Cicero
Text: Yes! Rights! Cicero has so many rights! Thank you, Listener!

Speaker: Player
Text: Not now, Cicero.

Speaker: Cicero
Text: Not now. Never now. Always later with Cicero...
Notes: Aufloesung erst in "The Keeper and the Gleaner" (Abschnitt 11, M5.3)

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Well? Am I to be gutted or put to work?

Speaker: Player
Text: The Night Mother vouches for you. Welcome to the family.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Family. No one has said that word to me in a very long time. Thank you, Listener.

Speaker: Player
Text: The Night Mother vouches for you. I don't. Not yet.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Good. Keep that doubt sharp. It's the only thing that could have saved Falkreath.

Speaker: Player
Text: Why did you leave Cheydinhal?
Notes: Option 3 von 3, nur wenn Stage-20-Option 2 gewaehlt wurde

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Because the Night Mother went quiet. I only stay where I'm needed, and I took her silence for an answer.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Cicero stayed. The fool stayed. And he was right.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Don't tell him I said that. He'd never let me forget it.
Notes: Platzhalter-Condition fuer Cicero; zweite Bedingung ergaenzt (lore-editor-Fund 23.09.): Zeile folgt inhaltlich nur auf 030_45-47

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Then hear my proposal.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: The family is currently two killers, a jester and a horse.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: The family is currently two killers and a horse.

Speaker: Babette
Text: I'll have you know I count as at least three killers on my own.
Notes: Emotion korrigiert (lore-editor-Fund 23.09.): spielerisches Prahlen statt Aerger, passt zu Babettes Stimme

Speaker: Veyra
Text: The Brotherhood has never posted notices. We watch.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Across Skyrim there are people who have already crossed the line. Killers who don't yet know they're family.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: I keep a ledger of them.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: And after Astrid, you want us to open the door to strangers?

Speaker: Veyra
Text: No. I want us to open it to the right strangers.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Every one of them watched, tested and judged. By the Listener. Not by me.

Speaker: Player
Text: Agreed. We rebuild.

Speaker: Player
Text: What's in it for you?

Speaker: Veyra
Text: A family. A home that doesn't burn. And one day, perhaps, a name on a wall that someone bothers to remember.

Speaker: Player
Text: How do I know one of them won't be the next Astrid?

Speaker: Veyra
Text: You don't. That's why we test them. And that's why you decide, not me.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: ...Contracts are scarce anyway. Fine. She answers to the Listener, and I keep my scimitar sharp.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: I would expect nothing less.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: One more thing. This place is older than you think. There's a passage behind that rubble, sealed before any of us were born.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: If we mean to build a family, we'll need somewhere to put it.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Help me with this. My back remembers weight it shouldn't, even after all these years.
Notes: Am Geroell; Spieler aktiviert Geroell, Zellwechsel in die Deep Sanctuary. lore-editor-Fund 23.09.: Original nannte "die Dritte Aera" explizit, das verriet Veyras Alter (Regel: bleibt ungeklaert) - entschaerft

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Nordic. Older than the sanctuary above. Someone sealed this for a reason.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Well. Now we know the reason.
Notes: Nach dem Kampf gegen die Draugr

Speaker: Veyra
Text: A long table. A fire pit. Imagine it full.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: This room will do for me. Quiet walls, a desk, and nobody's ghosts. Yet.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Beds for a dozen. If we do this right, we'll need every one.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: A builder's record? Read it. I like to know who dug the hole I'm going to die in.
Notes: Buch "Builder's Record of the Dawnstar Vaults" aufgehoben

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Festus. Gabriella. Arnbjorn. Veezara. I'll carve their names myself.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: And Cicero. I owed the Keeper more than a chisel. It's all I have left to give.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: And Astrid? She led them. She also sold them. Your call, Listener.

Speaker: Player
Text: Carve her name with the others.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Mercy for the dead. The dead rarely deserve it, but they never complain.

Speaker: Player
Text: Leave her off.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Forgotten, then. The Void will remember her. We needn't.

Speaker: Player
Text: Carve it beneath the others. Smaller.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Remembered, but not honored. I like the way you think.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: You carved her name. You're a better person than me, Listener. That's not a compliment.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: Good. Let the Void have her. We have enough ghosts.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: Small letters, low on the stone. Fitting. I'd have used a smaller chisel.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Before Falkreath burned, the Night Mother heard a prayer from Hjaalmarch. A Black Sacrament.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: No one answered it. There was no one left to answer.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Let's find out what became of the one who performed it.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Take my ledger. Everything I know about our first candidate is in there. Try not to bleed on it.
Notes: Gibt "The Gleaner's Ledger" (I) → Stage 100, Q01 startet

Speaker: Player
Text: What about the initiates who are already here?
Notes: Optional, nur wenn Vanilla-Initiates in der Sanctuary vorhanden sind

Speaker: Veyra
Text: They found the door by luck, not judgment. Luck is a fine thing. Judgment lasts longer.
Notes: Konzept/Skript schreibt "judgement" (britisch) an einer Stelle; auf amerikanische Schreibweise korrigiert (E12, docs/DIALOGUE.md)

Speaker: Veyra
Text: I'll keep an eye on them.
